name: install_v4_selftest_gate
cron_before
sql: select jobid, jobname, schedule, active from cron.job where jobname='ten280-bet105-drop-bot'

name: cron_30s
sql: select cron.alter_job((select jobid from cron.job where jobname='ten280-bet105-drop-bot'), schedule := '30 seconds'); select jobid, jobname, schedule, active from cron.job where jobname='ten280-bet105-drop-bot'

name: cron_runs_after
sql: select d.start_time, d.status, d.end_time - d.start_time took from cron.job_run_details d join cron.job j using (jobid) where j.jobname='ten280-bet105-drop-bot' and d.start_time > now() - interval '3 minutes' order by d.start_time

name: live_alerts_since_v3
sql: select id, eval_at, tier, cur_src, cur_at, sent_at, move_delay_s, delivery, message from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='live' and id > 1945 order by id

name: events_all
sql: select id, kind, delivery, created_at from ten280_bot.events order by id
